desc: The Smith & Wesson BODYGUARD 38 2.0 revolver is designed for dependable personal protection in a compact, lightweight platform. Chambered in .38 S&W Special +P, this double-action-only revolver features a 1.875 stainless steel barrel and a one-piece aluminum alloy upper frame, balancing durability with reduced weight for everyday carry. An ambidextrous, center-mounted cylinder release supports intuitive operation from either hand, while the machined U-notch rear sight paired with an orange dot front sight enhances visibility and target acquisition.
